name: Worker Co-op Slack (USFWC)
description: A Slack workspace run by the U.S. Federation of Worker Cooperatives for the worker co-op community, with channels for member councils, regional and peer networks, Spanish-speaking cooperatives, the energy sector, finance/accounting practices, and general announcements, plus a #principlesix channel for co-ops to share resources and opportunities with each other. Supplements rather than replaces USFWC's email list. Join via the invite link on USFWC's Connect page.
